chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: I doubt while I am in sajdah, and I do not know whether I performed rukuʿ or not. He said: Proceed.

key_terms.سَاجِدٌ: being in the state of sajdah (prostration)

ai.seo_question: What should one do if he doubts during sajdah whether he performed rukuʿ in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt during salat (prayer). If a person doubts while already in sajdah whether he performed rukuʿ, he should continue and not return, indicating that doubt after moving past a stage is disregarded.
